status: Frozen v2 candidate for final root review. Includes only the separately authorized Swiss-only preparatory L-wrap input selection. Full six-case acquisition, application comparison and product implementation remain unapproved until root explicitly approves this digest.
purpose: Six representative independent complete natal-to-strict-next-lunar-return cases and separated component gates. These are engineering acceptance tests, not a published accuracy guarantee or an exhaustive certificate for the supported date range.

prerequisites.rootScopeAlreadyApproved: EN-only first release; complete known timed birth data; strict (after, upper] selection; DST fold/gap rejection; no profile/schema changes; dedicated image and ICS.
prerequisites.productExecutionGate: Root reviews this policy before acquisition, then the acquired immutable oracle and conditioning before any new application comparison or product implementation under this task. Release still requires cumulative build/check/test and genuine browser evidence.

definition.target: The numeric tropical geocentric Moon longitude at the supplied natal instant, normalized to [0,360). The transiting Moon is evaluated in its own ecliptic/equinox-of-date frame; do not precess the natal numeric target forward.
definition.selection: The first crossing strictly later than afterMilliseconds and at or before upperMilliseconds. If after equals the supplied birth instant, the identity crossing there is excluded and the subsequent revolution is selected.
definition.excludedSubstitutions: No lunar phase, new/full Moon, sidereal return, fixed-period addition, topocentric target, nearest-return selection, local-noon target or sign-only target.
definition.referenceClock: Record afterMilliseconds once on submit. Calculation retry retains this recorded reference; a fresh calculation records a new reference. The completed model and exports identify the recorded reference rather than implying a continuously live next event.
definition.inputPrecision: A complete known timed natal input and resolvable birthplace/timezone are required. Reject ambiguous/nonexistent local civil time and unverifiable cached/noon/sign-only data before solving. Complete fixtures use synthetic UTC inputs; DST/IANA correctness is separate product testing.

supportedTransportInterval.chronology: Require birthMilliseconds <= afterMilliseconds. Therefore a valid input pair's latest usable birth also cannot exceed afterMaximumInclusive.
supportedTransportInterval.earliestDayRationale: The already pinned planetary file begins at 1800-01-01. January 2 retains an explicit day of coverage margin for apparent/speed calls; do not claim January 1 is validated or fetch a preceding file silently.
supportedTransportInterval.latestReferenceRationale: upperMilliseconds = afterMilliseconds + 40*86400000 must remain inside the supported interval. Do not clip the scan, roll dates into 2200 or silently shorten its horizon.
supportedTransportInterval.clockMeaning: Z is the application's millisecond transport. Only cases explicitly marked UTC claim the pinned UTC conversion; historical/future nominal-UT1 cases do not claim exact civil UTC.

productScanContract.result: Sort and deduplicate valid crossings, require strictly increasing instants, and select the first. Throw a bounded no-return/range error if none exists; do not extend the horizon.
productScanContract.invalidInputs: Reject non-finite dates, target longitude, coordinates or steps; require range and chronology checks before iteration. Exact-zero, adjacent-window, 0/360 and antipodal rejection contracts remain separately covered with analytic inputs.
productScanContract.scopeLimit: The fixed six-hour step and 40-day horizon are directly checked on these cases. Sparse validation does not prove these bounds at every instant from 1800 to 2199.

provider.positionCall: swe_calc(jdTT, bodyId, SWIEPH|SPEED). Capture raw C six-tuples, status/flags and warning before any wrapper call can hide first-call information.
provider.frameAndCorrections: Apparent geocentric tropical longitude/latitude of the true ecliptic and equinox of date, with default Swiss nutation/correction path. Do not set J2000, NONUT, sidereal, topocentric, TRUEPOS, NOABERR or NOGDEFL flags.
provider.pathAndFiles: Set SE_EPHE_PATH and swe.set_ephe_path to the same existing pinned directory. Recheck original binary/runtime hashes, actual loaded DE441 file names, hashes and ranges. Reject all warnings and any fallback or changed returned flags.
provider.optionalTimeFiles: seleapsec.txt and swe_deltat.txt must remain absent. No runtime upgrade, Delta-T override, tidal-acceleration override or file replacement.

productModelDisclosure.moonPath: EclipticGeoMoon(MakeTime(date)) calculates the lunar state at that time and transforms it with precession/nutation to true ecliptic/equinox of date. It contains no explicit light-time, aberration or gravitational-deflection pass. Do not describe it as correction-identical to the Swiss apparent reference.
productModelDisclosure.timePath: AstroTime treats JavaScript numeric UTC and UT1 as approximately equal and adds its default Espenak-Meeus Delta-T model. Swiss's UTC-to-TT and UT1/Delta-T paths are preserved independently and are not tuned to the product.
productModelDisclosure.gateRationale: Retain the site's pre-existing 0.15-degree Moon positional acceptance budget as an explicitly chosen conservative engineering contract for each endpoint, allowing lunar-state, correction and clock-model differences. This is not derived from old or new application residuals and is not a provider-published error bound. A natal-derived return contains two endpoint budgets, so its separately enforced timing band uses their 0.30-degree sum; no fixed number of minutes is inferred from the Moon gate.

clockConversion.UTC: swe.utc_to_jd(..., GREG_CAL): preserve nominal calendar JD, JD TT, JD UT1 and TT-minus-nominal-UTC offset. Assert the case's intended offset at birth, scan bounds, roots and body/house chart instants; reject Swiss stale-leap-table UT1 reinterpretation. Root search uses UTC milliseconds mapped through the same checked conversion, never a silent mixed clock.
clockConversion.nominalUT1: swe.julday(..., GREG_CAL) from the numeric civil label; jdTT = jdUT1 + swe.deltat_ex(jdUT1, SWIEPH). Use this coherent convention for birth, reference, every scan/band sample and charts. ISO Z is numeric transport only.
clockConversion.referenceFormatting: Retain raw clock JD, JD TT, JD UT1 and root bracket. Serialize one consistent nearest-millisecond numeric transport and ISO label. Raw bracket width is numerical refinement precision, not physical clock accuracy.

gates.ownTargetResidualRationale: A six-hour bracket refined 24 times is at most 1.29 ms; the declared sampled speed ceiling of 25 degrees/day makes 0.00001 degree a loose solver-residual check. This same-engine consistency check is separate from all external accuracy gates.
gates.speedAndDirection: Record Swiss analytic speed and a matching +/-6-hour Swiss finite difference at natal and selected-return instants. Planetary speed residuals are diagnostics, not a new tight cross-model speed test. Moon crossings must be direct; node direction comparison applies only when both absolute speeds exceed the existing deadband. Every product speed must be finite and its retrograde flag agree with its own speed sign.
gates.latitudeDistanceScope: Preserve all six raw values; no latitude, distance, aspect-orb, house-placement-boundary or uniformly precise event-time claim is introduced by these longitude/angle gates.

independentAcquisitionRecipe.method: Implement a standalone Swiss-only scan using cumulative unwrapped Moon longitude and all target + 360*k levels. Do not import the site scanner, application source, JavaScript engine or product expected values. Include exact grid endpoints once, exclude the exact lower identity, and independently refine every level crossing and band boundary.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.rootRefinement: Bracket with the independent one-hour grid and refine each crossing by safeguarded bisection until its raw clock bracket is no wider than 0.1 seconds. Preserve bracket endpoints, signed residuals, evaluation IDs, flags and warnings. Do not substitute the production 24-iteration result or fixed mean-period arithmetic.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.timeBands: For each independent root, acquire both boundaries of the connected monotonic branch where Swiss unwrapped longitude is within +/-0.15 degree (fixed target) and +/-0.30 degree (natal-derived target) of that root's target level. Materialize both intervals before application execution and add only one second of formatting padding. Product fixed-external-target output must lie in its fixed-target band; complete natal-derived output must lie in its natal-derived band.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.completeChronology: Preserve all independent roots in the full 40-day interval, not only the first. Complete Moon-scanner comparison may check the same count/order/direction; the new next-return entrypoint must select the first. Preserve all near-miss endpoint checks so a permitted target shift cannot silently move the selected revolution.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.chartAtIndependentInstant: At each selected independent event's rounded millisecond transport, acquire Sun through Pluto plus true North Node and raw houses/ASC/MC. Evaluate all coordinates at that same recorded clock. House calls use model-derived UT1 for UTC cases and declared UT1 for nominal-UT1 cases, flags 0 and the declared location/system.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.sameTimeReturnedChart: A later, separately retained supplement may acquire Swiss coordinates at the actual product-return timestamp after root has approved the first oracle and authorized product comparison. Only the timestamp may come from the product; location/system come from this policy. The independent event-time bands remain unchanged. Do not compare angles/houses at shifted event clocks or claim full returned-chart parity from component checks alone. This supplement is not run during policy preparation or initial independent acquisition.
independentAcquisitionRecipe.sourceRetention: Write a new raw oracle, compressed append-only evaluation journal, policy/recipe hashes, runtime and acquisition receipts and separate failure/partial logs in this Wave20 directory. Preserve every attempted tuple and failed conditioning result. Do not overwrite or fold product results into raw provider evidence; keep all Wave19 evidence untouched.

conditioning.endpointMargins: Every nonidentity search endpoint must lie more than 0.30 degree from any target level, and each materialized padded band must remain strictly inside its window and disjoint from all other bands. An after==birth lower endpoint is exempt only because target and initial Moon are the identical evaluation in each model; explicitly exclude that identity root. The following event's band must still be interior.
conditioning.monotonicity: Require increasing unwrapped Moon longitude, positive finite Moon analytic speed in the declared broad range at every Moon journal sample, and no Moon speed sign reversal or angular discontinuity. These directional conditions do not apply to other chart bodies. Record sampled extrema and six-hour advances. These are checked sample conditions, not a formal global derivative proof.
conditioning.modernMotionContrastScope: Record the absolute difference between the independent selected-return analytic speeds and whether it reaches 1 degree/day. If it does, label faster/slower from the oracle. If it does not, report the coverage limitation as a diagnostic without failing otherwise valid fixed fixtures or silently replacing dates. Any new contrast case requires a separate source-only reviewed policy amendment.
conditioning.yearBoundary: L-year-boundary starts at the last millisecond of 2025 by identity; its selected next event must be in 2026.
conditioning.failurePolicy: Stop and retain failures. Do not widen a tolerance, loosen a condition, switch flags/time models, replace dates, fetch different ephemerides, shorten a horizon or import application-derived expectations to make the acquisition pass. Root must review any separate revised policy before a new attempt.

preparatoryInputSelection.authorization: root-review-v1.md; only L-wrap first-0-degree source lookup was authorized before final v2 review.
preparatoryInputSelection.method: Standalone hourly cumulative Swiss Moon longitude scan followed by <=1ms sign-bracket bisection; no application imports or residual inspection.
preparatoryInputSelection.rounding: Nearest millisecond of the retained independent bracket midpoint. Retain the sub-millisecond bracket separately; the exact selected timestamp has its own recorded Swiss tuple and is not forced to exactly zero longitude.
preparatoryInputSelection.scope: This source-only input selection is not full lunar-return acquisition or a product validation result.
